ported.name: MobileSAM (ONNX)
ported.author: Chaoning Zhang et al. (MobileSAM); Meta AI (Segment Anything); ONNX export by Acly
ported.note: Bundled segmentation model: click objects in the digitizer to keep, remove or separate them. Runs on the device (ONNX Runtime Web).

ported.name: DexiNed (ONNX)
ported.author: Xavier Soria Poma; OpenCV model zoo
ported.note: Bundled edge detection model for line art in the digitizer.

ported.name: Informative Drawings (ONNX)
ported.author: Caroline Chan, Frédo Durand, Phillip Isola (Learning to generate line drawings that convey geometry and semantics, CVPR 2022); ONNX export by Joseph Rocca
ported.note: Bundled line-drawing model: turns photos and illustrations into line art for the digitizer. Runs on the device (ONNX Runtime Web).

ported.name: Tesseract OCR + English data
ported.author: Tesseract contributors; tesseract.js contributors
ported.note: Bundled text recognition: text in a picture becomes real embroidery lettering.

ported.name: Research the digitizer builds on
ported.note: Hoshyari et al., Perception-Driven Semi-Structured Boundary Vectorization (SIGGRAPH 2018); Kopf & Lischinski, Depixelizing Pixel Art (SIGGRAPH 2011); Kang, Lee & Chui, Coherent Line Drawing / Flow-Based Image Abstraction (NPAR 2007, TVCG 2009); Du et al., Image Vectorization via Linear Gradient Layer Decomposition (SIGGRAPH 2023); Liu et al., Directionality-Aware Design of Embroidery Patterns (CGF 2023); Jobard & Lefer, Evenly-Spaced Streamlines (1997); Noris et al., Topology-Driven Vectorization of Clean Line Drawings (TOG 2013) and Favreau et al., Fidelity vs. Simplicity (SIGGRAPH 2016) for the line strokes; Steger, An Unbiased Detector of Curvilinear Structures (TPAMI 1998) for sub-pixel line centres; VTracer (MIT) for the shared-boundary idea.

ported.name: Ink/Stitch
ported.author: Ink/Stitch authors
ported.note: Stitch algorithms (running, ripple, satin, tatami, contour, meander, guided and circular fills, underlay, lettering layout) and the SVG parameter dialect with commands and markers are ported from Ink/Stitch. Bundled resources: 75 thread charts (palettes/), 75 meander tiles (tiles/), command symbols and markers (symbols/) and the embroidery fonts whose licences allow it (the non-commercial ones are an optional download, Preferences ▸ Downloads).

ported.name: Madeira Cotona colour charts
ported.license: colours sampled from published colour cards
ported.author: Madeira Garnfabrik; Madeira USA / Quilting Thread
ported.note: Madeira Cotona 50 / 30 / 80 charts (120 colours) sampled from Madeira's Cotona colour card and the Madeira USA Cotona colour card by scripts/bundle-cotona.mjs. Screen colours are approximate; Madeira and Cotona are trademarks of Madeira Garnfabrik.

ported.name: Embroidery Nerds thread charts
ported.author: Matthew Enderle, The Embroidery Nerds, LLC
ported.note: 164 thread charts (corel-swatches, from the embroiderynerd.io thread database). No licence is stated, so they are not included: Preferences ▸ Downloads fetches them from the author's repository and converts them to .gpl on the user's device. Thread names may be trademarks of their owners and are used for description only.

ported.name: pystitch (Ink/Stitch)
ported.author: Tatarize and contributors
ported.note: Embroidery file encoders and decoders (DST, PES, PEC, JEF, EXP, VP3, XXX, U01, TBF, SEW, HUS and the other pystitch formats, CSV, TXT, G-code, COL/EDR/INF) are ported from pystitch, the file library Ink/Stitch writes machine files with (a fork of pyembroidery by Tatarize).
